high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "peachrinq." The post features a photograph of a manhole cover on a sidewalk. The manhole cover has a textured diamond pattern and prominently displays the letters "S.P.Q.R." in raised metal. Below the letters, there is another inscription that reads "FONDERIA ROMANA," indicating the manufacturer. The photo appears to have been taken outdoors, as part of a sidewalk is visible around the manhole cover.
